The fee structure of NOWPayments is fundamentally different from conventional platform fees. NOWPayments charges 0.5% per transaction. Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

The transaction log in a COREMERCH deployment provides a complete, independently verifiable audit trail of every payment. Each entry includes the transaction hash, which links directly to the public blockchain record. You can verify any transaction independently on Tronscan, Etherscan, Solscan, or the relevant blockchain explorer — no platform intermediary required, no dependency on NOWPayments' records. If a buyer claims they paid but the transaction does not appear in your order log, you check the blockchain directly. If a transaction confirmed on-chain but the delivery webhook did not fire, the order log flags the discrepancy for manual review. This level of cryptographic verifiability is structurally impossible with conventional payment processors, where transaction data is owned by the platform and accessible only through their APIs and dashboards.
